text:
Riley (AE): Handing off HaloAI. Contract signed today. Target: Dedicated w/ optional private peering later. Must-haves: SAML SSO, KMS encryption, audit logs to Splunk, and regional deployment in us-east-1 for data residency. Customer contact: partnerships@haloai.health. They want an enablement session for product + security teams next week. Renewal flagged as Q3; procurement lead time noted as a renewal risk if onboarding slips >21 days. Need a CSM owner and CS->eng escalation plan.

Ana (CSM): Ill own onboarding & enablement. Can someone confirm AWS acct and drop SAML metadata? Also want a list of critical prompts and any expected concurrency for capacity planning.

Tom (Platform SE): Staging cluster up in dedicated-useast1. Need their VPC CIDR for peering and SAML metadata. Recommend starting with int8-quant model to reduce cost for pilot; will provide footprint matrix. I'll open infra ticket unless Jordan already has one.

Jordan (Support): Opening ticket now: <https://redwood.example.com/tickets/9001|ticket-9001>. Tags: haloai, dedicated, splunk, kms. Assigning to Tom + infra. ETA triage 4h. ops-bot will post updates. :gear:

Riley (AE): Customer AWS acct 333444555666. They'll expect a smoke test before any PHI ingestion. Also asked about retention policy and whether logs can be forwarded to their Splunk instance. Ana - pls add to enablement scope.

Ana (CSM): Scheduled a 60min enablement block Tues 9am ET tentative; will confirm after ticket shows peering validated. Owners: Ana = CSM/onboarding; Tom = infra/ops; Jordan = support triage; Riley = sales escalation/DPA follow-up. Any objections?

Tom (Platform SE): Posting peering snippet in ticket-9001. Customer-side example:

```
# Add route for Redwood peering
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0def5678 --destination-cidr-block 10.80.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0d4c3b2a1f
```

Tom (Platform SE): Also uploading recommended SG rules and KMS key policy template to ticket-9001. Enabling KV prefix cache suggested for clinician templates to lower latency and token usage.

ops-bot: ticket-9001 status: created -> triage_pending. Next update expected in ~3h.

Jordan (Support): Linked onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/haloai. Marking demo blocked until peering + SAML metadata validated. Will run smoke test and post results here. :white_check_mark:

Ana (CSM): I'll collect their prompt set and clinician workflows ahead of the session. After enablement we'll run a short survey and file any quality regressions to Research. I'll also include a slide on Redwood Optimize options (batching + quantization) to address their cost questions. Adding renewal_watch tag in CRM due to procurement timeline sensitivity.

Riley (AE): I'll follow up on DPA and Splunk forwarding details. Quick ask: can we prepare a short checklist for compliance team showing audit log retention options? Ana - maybe include in enablement pack.

Ana (CSM): Will do. Action items recap: 1) Jordan -> create/triage ticket-9001 and validate peering. 2) Tom -> upload SG + KMS policy + model footprint. 3) Ana -> send invite after peering validated, prep enablement deck & compliance checklist. 4) Riley -> DPA + Splunk details. Ping here if anything blocks.
